cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says government payments are checked against the national ID or a social registry. The safety-net payments are reported in March 2024 with no date of their own.
cells.note: The CMSS pays pensions by mobile (July 2026) and a March 2024 World Bank blog reports Jigisemejiri safety-net recipients paid into mobile money accounts: two main streams, so stage 4. No check against the ID or a registry is held.
